{"action":"propose_candidate","purpose":"直接调用实数快速傅里叶变换，减少通用卷积的分派、形状处理及逆变换临时内存开销。","expected_result":"保持双精度全卷积的数值正确性，并使所有开发样本比初始程序更快。","verification":"由原生评估器检查输出形状和相对误差，并比较候选与基线的完整计时范围。","hypothesis":"已知输入是一维实数组，省略通用 signal.convolve 的处理并允许逆变换覆盖频谱，可以减少固定开销和内存分配。","analysis":null,"tool":null,"candidate_id":null,"parent_candidate_id":"c0","code":"import numpy as np
from scipy.fft import rfft, irfft, next_fast_len


def solve(problem):
    a, b = problem
    na, nb = len(a), len(b)
    if min(na, nb) <= 32 or na * nb <= 8192:
        return np.convolve(a, b, mode='full')
    size = na + nb - 1
    n = next_fast_len(size, real=True)
    fa = rfft(a, n=n)
    fb = rfft(b, n=n)
    fa *= fb
    return irfft(fa, n=n, overwrite_x=True)[:size]
","finish_reason":null}
